neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 pill bar (4 tall, stop dot), determinate and indeterminate.

windows.notes: v3's TcxProgressBar with NativeStyle: 21 tall (DFM default height), 1 px frame, flat square green fill inside it, percent centred (ShowTextStyle cxtsText: black on the track, white over the fill), marquee as one travelling segment. Read from import.vcl.form.dfm; no capture of a v3 progress bar exists.
gaps: No v3 capture of a progress bar: the frame #BCBCBC, track #E6E6E6 and fill #06B025 are the Windows 10/11 comctl theme from memory
Marquee segment width (a fifth of the bar) and speed (2 s) are guesses; the native glow highlight is not drawn
Text is Segoe UI 11.2 px; v3 sets Tahoma 8 pt (Height -11) for this bar
Not implemented: BarStyle cxbsGradient (main form: 0,89,130 to 0,62,91), vertical Orientation and PeakValue (statistics form), disabled state, error and paused tones
progress_ring keeps the Neper look (v3 has none)

neper.notes: The baseline: the dark plain tooltip and the raised rich tooltip.

windows.notes: v3's TcxHintStyle window: square, white face, 1 px #767676 frame, black Segoe UI 11.2 px text with 4 x 2 px padding, shown below its anchor with no fade or scale; lines break only where the text does. Colours and padding read off the grid header hint capture docs/grid-parity/T1-header-hint-v5.png (the v5 grid, recorded as matching v3 in D2430); v3 sets Tahoma 8 pt for the hint (hscMain.HintStyle.Font).
gaps: No capture of the real v3 hint itself: the look is taken from the v5 header hint that was matched to it
Font is Segoe UI 11.2 px, v3 configures Tahoma 8 pt (Height -11) for hint and caption
Padding, the 320 px cap on the plate and the 4 px gap under the anchor are fitted, not measured
The v3 hint has a drop shadow on some Windows versions; none is drawn
Rich tooltip action buttons keep the Neper text-button look and are not in the sheet
The sheet holds five cells: a sixth overlay made the harness frame an InvalidTree (probably its 16384-command limit)
Dark and high-contrast Windows palettes keep Neper colours with the Windows shape

neper.notes: The baseline: the v2 card over a scrim. Also neper/dialog_message.png (alert with icon) and neper/title_bar.png (the frameless title bar).

windows.notes: v3's Options window chrome: the dark Windows 11 caption (#1F2022, white Segoe UI 12 px title at 31, a 34 x 30 close button with a 10 px X, red hover), a #F0F0F0 face with 8 px corners, and the button row bottom right (9 from the right, 7 from the bottom, 75 x 22, 9 apart, accent-bordered default), no scrim. Caption colours, height, title position, X size and button geometry measured from 00-options-interface-controls-v3.png against windows/dialog@1.5x.png. Also windows/dialog_message.png (stock white message area, icon, grey button strip) and windows/title_bar.png (navigation.title_bar under the Windows profile).
gaps: Dialog width is a fixed 420 and the body padding (12, message box 20) is a guess; v3 sizes each form by hand
The app icon in the caption is not drawn (the title bar draws a menu glyph placeholder); v3 shows the program icon at 9 px in
No window shadow: the engine draws a hard offset shadow, Windows 11 a soft one; the real window also has a 1 px DWM border
The caption is 30 px tall and the close button 34 wide as measured, but win.caption_layout (hit testing for title_bar) still says 32 and 46
Inactive caption (#2B2B2B), min/max hover (white 8 %), close hover and pressed colours, and the message icon (a Primary-coloured Warning glyph) are guesses; no capture exists
The message box layout is the stock Windows one from memory; v3 has no captured message box
Accelerator underlines (Apply, with the A underlined) are not drawn
Dark and high-contrast Windows palettes keep Neper colours with the Windows metrics
Rich sheets in one frame are limited to what the harness runtime holds, so the overlay dialog is rendered alone per sheet
